newsitem.title: USA: NASDAQ to delist bankrupt Best Products - company.
newsitem.headline: NASDAQ to delist bankrupt Best Products - company.

text.p: Best Products Company Inc. said Wednesday the NASDAQ Stock Market system would delist the Richmond-based chain's stock effective from the start of business on Friday.
The chain filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on Sept 24 and sold nearly all its assets for liquidation purposes on Nov. 19.
Company spokesman Ross Richardson told Reuters that Best would not appeal NASDAQ's decision to delist its stock.
The stock will continue to trade over-the-counter.
Best, a catalogue showroom retailer, is in the process of shutting down by conducting liquidation sales at its stores.
